systems_found: Arizona Board of Regents (ASU, University of Arizona, NAU)
Arizona community college districts (Maricopa County CCD, Pima CCD, and ~8 other county districts)

sources.coverage_years: calendar years 2018-2025 (one CSV per year; 2018 also XLSX; '2023 revised' and '2024 revised' files)
sources.update_frequency: annual (State Press records request each fall)
sources.terms: not stated (student newspaper; public records obtained from ASU)
sources.notes: Public GitHub repo behind the State Press embedded viewer (thestatepress.github.io/SalaryList). Header names vary slightly by year (e.g. 2018 'Jobcode Descr','Fte' as fraction; 2025 salary formatted as '$5,800,000' and FTE as 100). Base salary only, no other/total pay.

sources.download_url: https://flo.uri.sh/visualisation/16806493/embed (Flourish embed; full dataset is embedded as JSON in the page variable _Flourish_data)
sources.size: ~15 MB embed page; 107,080 rows (12.5k-14.8k per year)
sources.terms: not stated (news organization; data compiled by University of Arizona via public records request)
sources.notes: One HTTP request yields all 8 years as clean JSON rows; verified row counts by year. Third-party (nonprofit newsroom), not official. Daily Wildcat also published earlier UA salary databases (2016-17, 2017-18, 2019-20) and Arizona Daily Star/tucson.com had a 2016 database.

sources.institution: Arizona public employees incl. ASU, UA, NAU and community colleges (Arizona Republic / AZ Data Central)
sources.institutions_covered: ASU, UA, NAU, community college districts, state agencies
sources.blocker: Search-only and paywalled (subscriber) for recent years
sources.notes: Only known source naming NAU employees beyond aggregators.

sources.institution: Arizona public employees incl. universities and community colleges (aggregator)
sources.institutions_covered: ASU, UA, NAU, Maricopa CCD, Pima CC and others
sources.blocker: Search-only; browsing capped at top 10,000 rows; no bulk download
sources.notes: Best available coverage for NAU and community college districts.

sources.size: FY26 budget book 7.2 MB / 61 pages; FY24 BUDDIES 1 MB / 190 pages
sources.blocker: Budget books are cost-center level only (checked FY26 book and FY24 BUDDIES); no names
sources.notes: A 2017 State Press editorial said NAU published all salaries in budget documents; current documents no longer do.

sources.institution: Arizona Board of Regents personnel report

private_extra: None found beyond IRS 990s (Grand Canyon University is for-profit/now nonprofit; no extra pay data seen).
gaps: No official (university-hosted) person-level salary files for ASU, UA or NAU; both A sources are newsroom republications of records-request data. NAU has no free person-level source. Community college districts (Maricopa, Pima, etc.) have no person-level source other than OpenTheBooks/azcentral.
notes: Rated the State Press GitHub CSVs and Arizona Luminaria Flourish JSON as A because each is a clean bulk file reachable without login; flagged as third-party. Peeked only CSV headers (byte range) and counted Flourish rows; no large downloads.
